text_block_list.text:
After finishing our outing with Zenno Rob 
Roy, when I suggested it was about time to 
head home—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: U-Um... Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, if it's okay with you... could you 
stay with me a little longer after 
this...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... there's somewhere I absolutely have 
to go today...!

Where we were brought was a stage in town. 
There, an event was underway where anyone 
could jump in and show off whatever talent 
they liked.
choice_data_list: Is Rob Roy taking the stage too?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! U-Um, I memorized a short story! 
I was thinking... I c-c-could read it 
aloud to everyone...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Y-Yes...! I-I'll give it a try...! 
Uuu...

text_block_list.name: Male MC
text_block_list.text:
――OK! Alright, who wants to take the stage 
next? Raise your hands! C'mon!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: U-U-Um...

text_block_list.name: Man in Front of Stage
text_block_list.text: Pick me, pick me!! I'll do it!

text_block_list.name: Male MC
text_block_list.text:
Alright, how about you over there! Come on 
up to the stage!

Zenno Rob Roy tried to step forward, but 
couldn't quite raise her voice. Even so, 
she had no intention of giving up. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Male MC
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, only two spots left! Who wants 
to get up on stage next?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ngggh! U-Um, uh, umm...! U-Uuuu...!

text_block_list.name: Male MC
text_block_list.text: Come on, how about it! Any more takers~~?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees!!!

text_block_list.name: Male MC
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Energetic Umamusume with the glasses 
over there! Come on up to the stage!

text_block_list.name: Male MC
text_block_list.text:
OK! So, what kind of performance are you 
going to show me now?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "U-Um... well, how was my performance—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Huh, wh-what...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(...Nothing is coming to mind... My head 
is completely blank—)

text_block_list.name: Audience in Front of Stage
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what's wrong...? Is she gonna be 
okay...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(E-Everyone's looking at me...! Wh-What 
should I do...?!)

Zenno Rob Roy is on the verge of being 
overwhelmed by nervousness. But seeing how 
she gathered her courage and raised her 
hand—I put all my faith into my gaze—
choice_data_list: (You can do it! I believe in you...!)
(You can do it! I know you can...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (...! Trainer...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Th-That's right...! I'm going to change! 
That's the whole reason I'm standing 
here...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Overcome the wall...! Break right 
through! Become a proud hero...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (I will write my own story...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Nnnrgh! E-Everyone...!! I-I'm Zenno Rob 
Roy...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm a student at Tracen Academy...! 
P-Please come watch me run in the 
races...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Please...!

text_block_list.name: Audience in Front of Stage
text_block_list.text:
Looking good! I'll be there to cheer you 
on~~!!

Zenno Rob Roy gave her greeting with all 
her heart, and was met with warm applause.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... Ah, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I... I did it!! It wasn't quite what I 
envisioned... but I was able to get up on 
stage and speak!
choice_data_list: Spot-on!! I really felt your emotions!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Really!? Yay...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, it was all thanks to you, 
Trainer...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I've never been good at expressing myself, 
and I fade into the background... I wanted 
to change that part of me, but I just 
couldn't.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Still, spending time with you, Trainer, 
realizing what I'm good at, and gaining 
confidence bit by bit...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I started to believe that somehow 
everything would be okay! And that's why I 
was able to stand on stage...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer is always the one who guides me. 
That is why—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
As long as you're by my side, Trainer, I 
feel like I can keep pushing forward...!
choice_data_list:
I'll keep watching you grow from here on 
out!

I'll keep watching you grow from here on 
out!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "I-I did it...! Ehehe!"
choice_data_list: Alright, let's aim to hold a solo event!

That's another step closer to becoming a 
hero!

That's another step closer to becoming a 
hero!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "I-I did it...! Ehehe!"
choice_data_list: Alright, let's aim to hold a solo event!

That's another step closer to becoming a 
hero!

That's another step closer to becoming a 
hero!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Eh...!? A-A solo event...!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
D-Does that mean... I'll be on stage all 
by myself for hours, with the a-audience 
staring—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uuu... My head's starting to spin...

And so, Zenno Rob Roy's rich imagination 
ended up completely backfiring on her...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a celebration...? I-It's not like I 
did anything that big...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... B-But! In that case, I'd love to go 
to that family restaurant from the other 
day...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... I thought that now, I might finally 
be able to say it. "Carrot hamburg steak, 
please!" like that...!

Afterward, the two of us celebrated at a 
family restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes! There's still a long way to go, 
but...! Someday, though—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I will become a hero no matter what! A 
hero who is remembered and loved by 
all...!"

Zenno Rob Roy went on to share the grand 
ambitions she kept hidden in her heart.
